translations.web: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak: not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.
translations.bsb: Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.
translations.kjv: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
translations.asv: but even as we have been approved of God to be intrusted with the gospel, so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God who proveth our hearts.
